notes.title: Steam Deck Support
notes.notes:
[strike]While we are waiting to get that precious green "[b]Verified[/b]" badge,[/strike][b]*[/b] we are glad to announce that Forgotten Hill the Wardrobe is fully playable on Steam Deck, both "on the go" than docked, as it also fully supports gamepad controls!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187513/1c4c3bfac163de99114fb303e7a4cf8c22293a70.png[/img]

If you are having issues at the first launch with Steam Deck controls not responding, make sure that the selected Button Layout is "Gamepad". 

This also means you can play the whole game with an XBox/Play Station controller also from PC/Mac.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187513/bc661791995a020bf0e7f74ca8a8a57c86228206.gif[/img]

Now that the horrors of the Wardrobe will come out from you Steam Deck too, are you sure you will survive? Let us know!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2891870/Forgotten_Hill_The_Wardrobe/

[b]*and we are finally verified![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187513/e6ec9cdecb0247129113d8d5b8f4a35e84d678b4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: One month patch - November 18th
notes.notes:
Hi everyone and thanks for getting into the wardrobe!

Thirty days have passed since the release of [b]Forgotten Hill The Wardrobe[/b] and here a small patch with the following fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed some typos in English, German and Chinese texts and made some slight changes in Birds Language Manual and Forgotten Flavor instructions to make them more clear. 
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 3 that allowed to interact with cards while reading the clue paper in the Insect Race puzzle
[*] Fixed an issue that could reset music volume when starting to Chapter 1
[*] Added a fallback in case Steam fails to unlock an achievement (if the connection drops for example): just visit in-game achievement page and click on the achievement icon to force a call.
[/list]
Hope you are enjoying the journey.

notes.title: Sunday October 20th patch
notes.notes:
Here are today's patch notes:
[list]
[*] fixed an issue that could have made the game crash in chapter 2.
[*] fixed a glitch with SFX in main menu that could reset sounds volume.
[*] changed some hints activation in chapter 2 that could have been misleading.
[*] fixed a few typos in English and Portuguese translations.
[/list]

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: October 19 patch
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, second day, first update:
we've fixed an issue in Chapter 5 that could have made the game crash when starting from main menu.
Please update when you can, Thanks!

notes.title: Forgotten Hill the Wardrobe is available!
notes.notes:
Nobody ever believed that the residents of Forgotten Hill had ordinary furniture like everyone else. But only the darkest, most twisted forces could have created something as evil as[b] The Wardrobe[/b]...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187513/a0736ef4b5a974606383ee2103cd4a7b85dc58de.png[/img]

[b]Forgotten Hill: The Wardrobe[/b] is now available on Steam, featuring all five chapters, plus an exclusive [b]Chapter Zero - The Crafting[/b]. Will you survive the horrors within?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2891870/Forgotten_Hill_The_Wardrobe/
